script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Joshua's victories are not described in this passage, and the explanation gives no reference for them.
Saying the LORD does not ask Israel to do it alone implies He asks Israel to drive out these inhabitants. The verse says He Himself will drive them out before the Israelites.
The claim that Joshua's army has done plenty of fighting is not stated in this passage and has no outside reference.
The joke makes the Bible's statement of the tribal portions sound strange, putting Scripture itself at the center of the joke.
The rest did not all receive land east of the Jordan. Levi received no land inheritance from Moses.
“That's the wrong direction” uses “wrong” about the baker's answer.
“Awkward” suggests a social situation or feeling that the passage does not describe.
The explanation broadens Levi's inheritance from the food offerings to whatever is given to the LORD. The claim that their share comes from the LORD's own table is also not stated in the passage.
“Their share was never about treasure” makes a broader claim about the purpose of Levi's inheritance than the passage states.
